aha: The shaft is three deep: all three stones (road, silo, shelf) must go in before the pearl can cross.
deadlocks: Pushing the pearl before all three stones are in: it drops into the shaft.
Digging up the silo pillar and stepping back down without side-stepping (crushed by the stone).
Pushing the road stone left from its right side: it can end up jammed against the pearl.
